title: refactor(driver-sql): codemod pilot — generated, byte-identity-proved section split of sql-driver.ts (#29520)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_

Fixes #29520

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:新增确定性 codemod 脚本 `scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs`,并附上它对 `sql-driver.ts` 生成的拆分结果(20 个方法体移入 10 个分节模块,类上留桩)。脚本自带逐字节证明与 `.d.ts` 判据,未手改任何生成文件。
- 为什么改:落实 #29465 裁决 A 的 phase 0 试点:证明「脚本按既有切法生成拆分、逐字节可验证」这条路走得通,以便窗口期在最新 main 上重跑而不是 rebase。
- 风险与回滚:纯搬移,行为不变。驱动三套测试计数与基线一致,发布的 `.d.ts` 逐字节相同(sha256 `0f33bf3f…`)。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。但实测收益很小:按裁决规定的切法,254 个方法里只有 20 个能搬,`sql-driver.ts` 仅从 18,333 行降到 18,225 行(−108)。
- 先看:① `scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs` 的 `readMethod` 与 `STAY_REASONS`(决定什么能搬);② `verify`(逐字节证明);③ `sql-driver.ts` 中任一 `[#29520 codemod]` 桩。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs --verify --base b16ee8ba06`,预期看到 `20/20 moved bodies identical` 和 `undoing the split does rebuild the base byte-for-byte`,退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:就收益做决定:按当前切法合入这个小试点,还是另行裁决放宽切法,或按 B 方案分叉。数字见下方 Acceptance notes。

## What changes

- **`scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs`** (new). A deterministic ts-morph codemod that applies the hand series' cut pattern (#25521) to whole sections of `SqlDriver`:
  - Every section banner inside the class maps to a module through a declared table (`SECTION_MODULES`). An unknown banner stops the script with exit 2.
  - A method moves when nothing in `STAY_REASONS` applies. When it moves, its body goes unedited, not re-indented and not formatted, into an exported function of the same name in `sql-driver-SECTION.ts`. Its `this` is one named host (`SECTIONHost`, members typed as `SqlDriver['x']`).
  - The class keeps the method's docblock, modifiers and signature byte-for-byte. The only change is that `async` is dropped from a stub, as every async stub of the series did. The stub hands the body a host literal: methods as call-time closures, fields and accessors as getters.
  - **Proof 1, byte-identity** (`--write` runs it on its own output; `--verify --base REF` re-runs it from the texts alone). For every generated function, the body, parameters, return type and async flag equal the base method's text. Undoing the split (bodies back, `async` back, generated imports out) rebuilds the base `sql-driver.ts` byte-for-byte, so nothing else in the file moved.
  - **Proof 2, the declaration bar** of ruling 6348891160 item 1 (`--dts BEFORE AFTER` on two built dists). It checks the raw and normalised sha256 of `index.d.ts` and `index.d.mts` and the raw diff line count. Every differing line must be a union-member-order swap. It also checks the export list, plus the positive control (one private member made public must change the normalised hash).
  - `--self-test`: 23 cases in 4 pinned batteries, with a floor and a handshake. Each proof is fed an input it must refuse: an edited body character, an edited stub signature, an extra module statement, a retyped `.d.ts` member, a visibility change, an added line, a changed export list. It also exercises each stay rule and checks determinism.
  - ts-morph resolves through `@objectstack/cli`'s dependency closure (`createRequire(packages/cli/package.json)`, the way `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` resolves `tsx`). The root cannot reach `ts-morph` on its own, and **no dependency is added**. Every parse goes through `ts-parse.mjs`'s checked `parseSourceFile` first (`check:parse-guard`).
  - Not wired into CI and no `check:` alias: it is a tool the dev re-runs in the landing window. It is not a gate.
- **The generated split** (`node scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs --write`, unedited): 20 method bodies move from `sql-driver.ts` into 10 new section modules (`sql-driver-lifecycle.ts`, `-crud`, `-sequence-semantics`, `-bulk-operations`, `-aggregation`, `-managed-drift`, `-filter-helpers`, `-field-mapping`, `-column-creation`, `-database-helpers`). The class keeps 20 stubs, and one import line per module is added after the last import.

## Measurements

| Reading | Value |
|:--|:--|
| `sql-driver.ts` lines (`wc -l`) | 18,333 → 18,225 (−108): 263 body lines out, 135 stub lines in, 20 import and comment lines in. The script prints 18,334 → 18,226, because it also counts the empty string after the final newline |
| Methods | 20 of 254 move, into 10 of 23 sections. 13 sections move nothing |
| New module lines | 642 (10 files) |
| Byte-identity | 20/20 bodies, parameters, return types and async flags identical; undoing the split rebuilds the base byte-for-byte |
| Determinism | output tree sha256 `35afbb967b5aa063886af8a663d94969b88f0a73822a5f4b9677bb76925b4738` on three runs: plan run, `--write` at `dbca3ef034`, and `--write` again on merged main `b16ee8ba06` (main had not touched `sql-driver.ts`; input sha256 `e73b1ce9…` both times). The files on disk hash to the same value |
| `.d.ts` | raw = normalised = `0f33bf3febaac3c7aa96f68a4226d752766b8203ab7acade523b69f9aaa44d74` at base and head, for both `index.d.ts` and `index.d.mts`; 0 raw diff lines; positive control `8b716bae7c2a…` ≠ base |
| Export lists | `.d.ts` 92 = 92; runtime CJS 59 = 59 and ESM 59 = 59 (CJS = ESM) |
| Changed lines | 2,333 (+2,105 / −228, 12 files) per `dispatch-gates` |

<details><summary>Why most methods stay (stay reasons, counted per method; one method can carry several)</summary>

`module-value` 119 (the body reads a helper or constant that `sql-driver.ts` declares; importing it as a value would create the evaluation cycle the pattern forbids) · `already-moved` 78 (already a hand-series stub) · `tenant-chokepoint` 77 (`check-tenant-chokepoint` scans `sql-driver.ts` alone, so its read doors and D8 predicates stay where it reads them) · `no-yield` 43 (the stub would be no shorter than the body) · `parameter-shape` 21 · `this-write` 19 · `no-section` 14 · `static` 11 · `comment-in-parameters` 7 · `field-call` 6 · `inferred-return-type` 6 · `type-parameters` 3 · `name-taken` 3 · `module-local-type` 2 · `reserved-name` 1. The full per-method table is the script's plan output: run `node scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs` on an unsplit file.

</details>

## Tests

Each run was taken on the final head `9414843b4a`, after a rebuild of the driver closures. The base counts are cut 21's, and they are identical.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql test`: exit 0. 248 files (236 passed, 12 skipped); 4061 tests (3847 passed, 214 skipped).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-turso test`: exit 0. 95 files; 2526 tests (2492 passed, 34 skipped).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sqlite-wasm test`: exit 0. 39 files; 746 tests passed.
- `node scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, 23 cases in 4 batteries.
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed.

## Acceptance notes

1. **Yield (the seat's decision).** The binding cut pattern keeps most of the file where it is. 20/254 methods move and `sql-driver.ts` loses 108 lines (0.6%). These are the same limits that closed the hand series at cut 21. Measured upper bounds of relaxed variants (method counts only; no output was generated for them):
   - Admitting value imports from `sql-driver.ts` (an evaluation cycle, plus `export` on module-local helpers): 47 methods, 17,184 lines.
   - Also widening `check-tenant-chokepoint`'s `SCAN_FILES` (a gate change): 69 methods, 15,925 lines.
   - The ceiling stays low because docblocks stay on the class and 78 methods are already stubs.
2. **`no-yield` is this script's own rule.** Without it, the literal "whole section" reading moves 63 methods and *grows* `sql-driver.ts` to 18,398 lines (+65), because short bodies get longer stubs. Striking the rule is one line in `plan()`.
3. **Moved bodies are not re-indented.** The hand series re-indented by hand. Here byte-identity is plain text equality, so each function's body keeps the class's 4-space indentation and closes at 2 spaces. This is cosmetic only.
4. **Three section titles name a section the hand series already has a module for** (Raw Execution, Transactions, Schema Sync). The table gives those a `-section` suffix. None of the three moves anything in this run.
5. **Ruling 6348891160 item 3** forbade a `scripts/` file for the normaliser on that series. The later ruling 6583399215 orders the script's own declaration check, so the normaliser lives in this script, unwired and with no `check:` alias.
6. **Size.** 2,333 changed lines is under the 3,000 human-merge threshold. The PR stays a draft per the landing plan, which lands it only in the maintainer's window.
7. `skip-changeset`: per ruling 6348891160 item 4, a cut that meets item 1 (here the `.d.ts` is byte-identical) takes no changeset.

## Verification

- Byte-identity, re-run from the texts: `node scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs --verify --base b16ee8ba06` gives exit 0, `20/20 moved bodies identical`, and `undoing the split does rebuild the base byte-for-byte`.
- Declaration bar: build `@objectstack/driver-sql` at an unsplit `sql-driver.ts` and at the head, then run `node scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs --dts BEFORE_DIST AFTER_DIST`. Expected: exit 0, `declaration-file bar: PASS`. The normaliser one-liner is printed verbatim and reproduces `0f33bf3f…` when run by hand.
- Re-running in the landing window: restore `sql-driver.ts` from the latest `main`, delete the ten generated modules, run `--write`, commit. On an unchanged input the output tree hash is `35afbb96…`.

<details><summary>Gates at head 9414843b4a</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 65 families.
  - Each was run alone, with its exit captured before any pipe: 63 exit 0.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: they need a full `pnpm build`), so they are NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI.
  - The `--ran` reconciliation reads: 65 derived, 63 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (derived from a recorded exit 3), 0 UNRUN, exit 0.
  - `check:parse-guard` was red once on the first script commit (a raw `createSourceFile`). It was fixed in `ba014dfcb6` and is green at head.
- Hand gates, all exit 0: `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 12 changed files, `check-adr-anchors`, `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-nul-bytes`, `check-commit-card-trailers --range main..HEAD`.
- Base `dbca3ef034` against head:
  - `check-adr-anchors` counts 2221 decision-letter citations at both.
  - `check-tenant-chokepoint` output is byte-identical (24 `getBuilder()` bindings across 3 files).
  - `dist/index.mjs` carries 72 → 82 `.call(host` sites.
- The five `packages/cli` pin tests that read `sql-driver.ts` by path did not run locally: the `cli` closure was not built, and they failed at import with `@objectstack/lint/rule-explanations` unresolved. CI runs them. Every anchor they slice has the same count at base and head, and none lies in a moved body.
- Open PRs touching `packages/drivers/driver-sql/**`: none at start (49 open) and none before `pr_create` (48 open).

</details>
